name: C3b-desk-randdrop
cmd: set -e; export RESEARCH_OUT={out} TMPDIR={out}/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR={out}/tmp/mpl WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_DIR={out}; mkdir -p {out}/desk {out}/tmp; {python} scripts/run_encoder.py desk; {python} research/exp/cache.py --out {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_randdrop; ln -sfn {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1/esk_epochs.npz {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1_randdrop/esk_epochs.npz
note: E073 C3b: DESK T0 1996 seed 1 retrained with a random 30% of training cells dropped (matched control for C3)
